\section[lecker]{lecker — tasty}

\label{lesson:GE-C218-lecker}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for strong, then the German for single.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: lecker}
\textbf{lecker} — \textquotedblleft{}tasty\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{lecker} $\leftarrow$ Middle High German \emph{lecker} (EtymDB 2.1), from the verb \textquotedblleft{}to lick\textquotedblright{}, Old High German \emph{lecchōn}, English \emph{lick}: food worth licking your lips for.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{cousinweb}

\end{cousinweb}
